title: remove-federated-idp input
description: Remove a federated IdP. Without federated IdPs, the realm loses the write access to its user domain. Federated accounts stay in the user domain, and log in with a password only if an administrator sets one

domain.description: User domain, which is also the realm name

alias.description: Alias of the federated IdP in the realm. It is also the value of the federated account marker
